'use client';
// @generated by Revyme — Page Effects controller. Do not edit. @pt-scene-v6
import * as React from 'react';
import { usePathname, useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import * as RevymeRuntime from '@revyme/runtime';
import { PAGE_EFFECTS } from './page-effects';
import { resolvePageEffect, buildViewTransitionCSS, resolveTiming } from './page-effects-runtime';

export function PageTransitions({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const pathname = usePathname();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pending = React.useRef<null | { destination: string; resolve: () => void }>(null);
  const flight = React.useRef<AbortController | null>(null);
  const busy = React.useRef(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    if (pending.current?.destination === pathname) { pending.current.resolve();pending.current = null; }
  }, [pathname]);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    const effect = resolvePageEffect(PAGE_EFFECTS as any, location.pathname, location.pathname);
    if (!effect?.enter || ['displacement', 'glitch', 'ripple-water'].includes(effect.preset) || matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;
    const timing = resolveTiming(effect.enter.transition);
    const style = document.createElement('style');
    style.textContent = buildViewTransitionCSS(undefined, effect.enter) + '\n@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) { body { animation: ' + timing.duration + 's ' + timing.easing + ' ' + timing.delay + 's both revyme-vt-enter; } }';
    document.head.append(style);
    const timer = setTimeout(() => style.remove(), (timing.duration + timing.delay) * 1000 + 120);
    return () => { clearTimeout(timer);style.remove(); };
  }, []);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    function navigate(dest: URL): Promise<void> {
      return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        const timer = setTimeout(() => { pending.current = null;reject(Error('route-timeout')); }, 5000);
        pending.current = { destination: dest.pathname, resolve: () => { clearTimeout(timer);resolve(); } };
        React.startTransition(() => router.push(dest.pathname + dest.search + dest.hash));
      });
    }
    function onClick(event: MouseEvent) {
      const anchor = (event.target as Element)?.closest?.('a[href]') as HTMLAnchorElement | null;
      if (!anchor || event.defaultPrevented || event.button !== 0 || event.metaKey || event.ctrlKey || event.shiftKey || event.altKey) return;
      if ((anchor.target && anchor.target !== '_self') || anchor.hasAttribute('download') || anchor.hasAttribute('data-no-vt')) return;
      let dest: URL;
      try { dest = new URL(anchor.href, location.href); } catch { return; }
      if (dest.origin !== location.origin || dest.pathname === location.pathname) return;
      const effect = resolvePageEffect(PAGE_EFFECTS as any, location.pathname, dest.pathname);
      if (!effect) return;
      const snapshotEffect = ['displacement', 'glitch', 'ripple-water'].includes(effect.preset);
      if (!snapshotEffect && !(document as any).startViewTransition) return;
      event.preventDefault();event.stopImmediatePropagation();
      if (busy.current) return;
      busy.current = true;
      if (snapshotEffect) {
        const glitch = effect.preset === 'glitch';
        const ripple = effect.preset === 'ripple-water';
        const run: unknown = Reflect.get(RevymeRuntime, glitch ? 'runGlitchNavigation' : ripple ? 'runRippleNavigation' : 'runDisplacementNavigation');
        const normalize = Reflect.get(RevymeRuntime, glitch ? 'normalizeGlitch' : ripple ? 'normalizeRipple' : 'normalizeDisplacement');
        const config = typeof normalize === 'function' ? normalize(glitch ? effect.glitch : ripple ? effect.ripple : effect.displacement) : null;
        if (typeof run !== 'function' || !config) {
          document.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('revyme:page-transition', { detail: { phase: 'fallback', reason: 'runtime-unavailable' } }));
          void navigate(dest).catch(() => {}).finally(() => { busy.current = false; });return;
        }
        const controller = new AbortController();flight.current = controller;
        const origin = ripple && event.detail !== 0 ? { x: event.clientX / innerWidth, y: event.clientY / innerHeight } : undefined;
        void run({ config, navigate: () => navigate(dest), signal: controller.signal, origin })
          .finally(() => { busy.current = false;if (flight.current === controller) flight.current = null; });
        return;
      }
      const style = document.createElement('style');style.textContent = buildViewTransitionCSS(effect.exit, effect.enter);document.head.append(style);
      try {
        const transition = (document as any).startViewTransition(() => navigate(dest));
        void transition.finished.catch(() => {}).finally(() => { style.remove();busy.current = false; });
      } catch { style.remove();busy.current = false;void navigate(dest).catch(() => {}); }
    }
    // Preview's router emits popstate for push(); only unrelated history navigation cancels.
    const cancel = () => { if (pending.current?.destination !== location.pathname) flight.current?.abort(); };
    document.addEventListener('click', onClick, true);window.addEventListener('popstate', cancel);
    return () => { cancel();document.removeEventListener('click', onClick, true);window.removeEventListener('popstate', cancel);pending.current?.resolve();pending.current = null; };
  }, [router]);
  return <>{children}</>;
}
